messages:
incident-bot: :warning: Page triggered: KV_CACHE_HITRATE_ALERT in prod/eu-central-1 for service=inference-runtime. 25% of pods reporting hit_rate < 0.6 over 4m. Assigned to #eng-oncall.
Aisha G: Oncall Aisha - picking up. Any deploys or autoscaling events in the last 15m?
infra-bot: Recent events: model-rollout id=mv-421 completed 9m ago in eu-central-1; autoscaler unchanged. No node reboots.
Theo V: I'm looking at the cache metrics. Cluster hit_rate dropped from 0.92 to 0.55 starting at 2050000900. Eviction throughput spiked on a subset of nodes: pod-eu-12 ~ 380 evictions/s. Memory RSS for that pod climbed to 70GB.
Maya R: Checked logs for pod-eu-12: repeated large cache keys being inserted. Sample log line: `cache_insert key_len=24837 bytes model=mv-421 req_id=xyz` — that key length is much larger than normal. Looks like a malformed tokenization blob from the new model variant.
Aisha G: Ok immediate mitigations: 1) Shift traffic off the suspect pods; 2) Pin previous model variant for 10m; 3) Open temporary suppression for the hit-rate page channel for 25m while we stabilize. Who can run the route tweak?
Theo V: Running route split to move 30% to cold-warm pool: `redwood-route adjust --region eu-central-1 --from infer-runtime --to infer-runtime-warm --percent 30` -> applied.
infra-bot: Traffic shift succeeded. Observed avg latency on affected routes drop by ~90ms.
Maya R: I'm reverting the model rollout for mv-421 in eu-central-1 to mv-417 for the cohort. Command: `modelctl rollback --model mv-421 --to mv-417 --region eu-central-1` -> rollback initiated.
product-bot: Notifying stakeholders: rollback in progress for mv-421 in eu-central-1. Informing customers who use 'priority' tier.
Aisha G: While rollback runs, let's avoid a storm of pages. Proposal: update the alert to require a 5m sustained low hit-rate and add an eviction-based page rule. Also add a suppression during model_rollout events for 10m.
Theo V: Draft eviction page rule I can add:
```yaml
- alert: KVCacheEvictionSpike
  expr: sum by(pod)(rate(kv_cache.evictions_total[2m])) > 60
  for: 3m
  labels:
    severity: page
    team: eng-runtime
  annotations:
    summary: "Eviction spike on {{ $labels.pod }}"
    runbook: "https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-evictions"
```
Maya R: And an adjusted hit-rate rule suggestion:
```yaml
- alert: KVCacheHitRateLow_Sustained
  expr: avg_over_time(kv_cache.hit_rate[6m]) < 0.65
  for: 6m
  labels:
    severity: warning
    team: eng-oncall
  annotations:
    summary: "Sustained low KV cache hit rate (6m avg)"
    note: "Suppress if recent(model_rollout[10m]) > 0 or pod_restart_total > 0"
```
Aisha G: Good. Two additional asks: 1) Add a Grafana panel that surfaces 'large cache key inserts' histogram so model rollouts that create big keys are visible; 2) Add an alert that pages if >10k large-key inserts/5m. Anyone can draft that?
Theo V: Draft large-key insert alert:
```yaml
- alert: KVCacheLargeKeyInsertRate
  expr: sum(rate(kv_cache.large_key_inserts_total[5m])) by (cluster) > 10000
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: page
    team: eng-ml
  annotations:
    summary: "High rate of large cache key inserts in {{ $labels.cluster }}"
    runbook: "https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-large-keys"
```
infra-bot: Rollback completed. mv-417 serving in eu-central-1. Post-rollback metrics: pod-eu-12 memory use trending down; evictions falling to normal (<5/s); cluster hit_rate climbing back to 0.9 over 8m.
product-bot: Customer impact: two premium customers (Mapline, NovaSearch) reported degraded performance during the 12m window. CS ticket created and owners engaged. No SLO breaches.
Aisha G: Immediate status: stabilization looks good. We'll keep the temporary suppression for the 25m window I opened. Post-incident actions (to be tracked in PI ticket):
- Create Grafana panel for large-key inserts + histogram + example traces -> @Maya R
- Implement eviction spike alert and large-key insert page rule (PR) -> @Theo V
- Update runbook to include model-rollout suppression clause and quick rollback steps -> @Aisha G
- Add alert aggregation by customer cohort so CS can know which customers were affected -> @PS (product telemetry)
Maya R: I'll attach a sample log snippet and a short grep tool in the runbook for operators to find oversized keys quickly.
Theo V: I'll open PR for the three alert rule changes and include unit tests for suppression during `model_rollout` events.
Aisha G: Handoff: I'm off in 20m, Theo will be handoff oncall. Theo, confirm watches?
Theo V: Taking oncall. Watches: eviction spike alert, PR review, Grafana panel merge, monitor for re-firing for 1h. Acknowledge.
infra-bot: Metrics: hit_rate stabilized at 0.91, eviction rate baseline, large_key_inserts_count ~20 over last 10m.
Aisha G: Thanks team. I'll close the page channel when suppression window ends. Leaving thread open for follow-ups and the PI ticket link. :white_check_mark:
